parallel_corpus.description: Tatoeba/OPUS English with Gemini-generated Zomi, obtained from Hugging Face ZomiLearner/English-Zomi-OPUS_Tatoeba_v20230412
parallel_corpus.declared_license: CC0 1.0 (as labeled on the Hugging Face dataset page, reported by the project owner on 2026-10-25; not independently verified)
parallel_corpus.evidence: English side: Tatoeba sentences via OPUS (OPUS_Tatoeba_v20230412). Zomi side: machine-generated; 1,769,117 of 1,775,043 unique pairs name a Gemini model in the file's model column (gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-pro, gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-3-pro-preview), 5,926 name none. A CC0 label from the uploader does not by itself settle Tatoeba's attribution terms or the terms under which the Gemini output was generated; train stays needs_review until those are verified. See docs/DATA_RIGHTS.md.
